1.question: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
1.explanation: Each comparison halves the search space.

1.question: Which data structure works on Last In, First Out?
1.explanation: A stack removes the most recently added item first.

1.question: Which data structure works on First In, First Out?
1.explanation: A queue removes items in the order they were added.

1.question: Breadth-first search (BFS) uses which structure to track nodes?
1.explanation: BFS visits nodes level by level using a queue.

1.question: Which sorting algorithm has O(n log n) time in the worst case?
1.explanation: Merge sort always divides and merges in O(n log n).

1.question: Accessing the k-th element of a singly linked list takes:
1.explanation: You must follow k links from the head.

1.question: The average lookup time in a hash table is:
1.explanation: A good hash function spreads keys evenly, so lookups are constant time on average.

1.question: An in-order traversal of a binary search tree visits keys in:
1.explanation: Left subtree, node, right subtree gives ascending order in a BST.
